concerns.text: Fallback trigger 'if wall-clock time exceeds 5.5 hours' is measurable in principle but the measurement conditions are unspecified — wall-clock of what (a single bootstrap run? the full batch? on which hardware?). State the scope of the timed unit so an implementer can deterministically decide 1000 vs 100 iterations.

'Simulations must use MARTINI force field OR reduced system size' is a disjunction with no decision rule — an implementer cannot know which branch satisfies the requirement, and a tester cannot construct a pass/fail check. Specify the selection criterion (e.g., 'MARTINI; fall back to reduced system size only if X') or make it a single requirement.

'variance in D values < 5%' is ambiguous: variance has units of D², so '<5%' presumably means relative spread (e.g., coefficient of variation or max-min/mean). Name the exact dispersion statistic so the check is computable and reproducible.
